description: An Israeli air strike on Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis, southern Gaza, has killed six Palestinians and injured more than 20 others, including patients and medical staff, according to Gaza’s Civil Defence. The strike hit the hospital’s second floor, causing extensive damage to its intensive care and surgical wards. Some of those killed and injured were patients who had been staying at the hospital ahead of operations scheduled for the following day. Civil Defence teams have completed search and inspection operations at the site. The attack is the seventh reported Israeli strike on the medical complex, which is described as the only hospital still operating in Khan Younis and serves an estimated 500,000 people in southern Gaza.
